_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.errors. Maps backend / OAuth provider error codes to safe, locale-aware copy.
_meta.audience: End users who hit an authentication failure.
_meta.tone: Direct and reassuring. Tell the user what to do next; do not blame the user.
_meta.security: Provider-supplied error descriptions are never rendered. Translation strings must NOT mention internal mechanisms (database state, hash values, internal IDs).

alertTitles._use: Heading shown on top of an error alert. Keep ≤ 2 words after translation if possible.
alertTitles.loginFailed: Top of the alert shown after a sign-in attempt with email + password fails.
alertTitles.signupFailed: Top of the alert shown after a sign-up attempt fails.
alertTitles.signInFailed: Top of the alert shown after a third-party (OAuth) sign-in fails.

codes._use: Mapped from backend error codes. Always end with a recovery action where possible.
codes.rate_limited: Sent when the client is being rate-limited; do NOT mention specific retry intervals because they are dynamic.

oauth._use: Mapped from OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749 error codes (the URL `?error=` parameter). Provider-supplied descriptions are intentionally ignored.
oauth.fallback: Used when the OAuth error code is unknown; do not include the raw error code.
